newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-RAILWAY NEEDS CAPITAL TO BOOST TRANSIT - OMNITRAX.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-RAILWAY NEEDS CAPITAL TO BOOST TRANSIT - OMNITRAX.

text.p: Omnitrax, the US railway company interested in the privatisation of Estonian Railways, said on Monday that investments are needed for the railway to increase transit flow in Estonia.
As 90 percent of transit goods in Estonia go via rail, additional investments are needed to cope with increasing transit flows, Omnitrax vice president Dennis Lindberg said in a statement.
"Transit capacity will not increase substantially before privatisation brings investments," he added.
The longer the reorganisation will take, the more expensive it will be and Estonia's railway tariffs will not be competitive in the future, Lindberg said.
The government approved the privatisation plan of state-owned Estonian Railways (Eesti Raudtee) in May.
